minimum.notes: Each house-banked internet game requiring a wager must have RTP at or above 80% and at or below 100%, unless otherwise authorised by the Board. RTP must be calculated at BOTH the highest and lowest skill levels where skill affects RTP - relevant to any skill-influenced feature.

selfExclusion.notes: TWO SEPARATE SCHEMES. An integration that assumes one list per market will miss one of them.

consultantNotes: Michigan's 80%-100% band is notable for having an explicit UPPER bound as well as a lower one. A game must not be capable of exceeding 100% RTP in any configuration.
The requirement to compute RTP at both highest and lowest skill levels means any skill-influenced element needs two documented RTP figures in the PAR sheet, not one.
